skill_name: Classify paper towels into different types
workflow: Paper towels can be classified into several different types, including recycled, re-usable, jumbo/bulk/economy, economy-size/jumbo, and thick/strong. Recycled paper towels are made from 100% post-consumer recycled content and can help reduce waste. Re-usable paper towels are machine washable, making them a more cost-effective and environmentally friendly option. Jumbo/bulk/economy paper towels are larger in size and more cost-effective in the long-run since fewer sheets are needed. Economy-size/
